scope: Actual full inline JavaScript executed in Node VM with a minimal synthetic DOM and mocked Blob/URL/clipboard/download APIs. No browser layout, real filesystem download, browser clipboard or Godot acceptance.

checks.name: Actual generated report contains 17 unique capture panels and open defaults
All 17 capture switches preserve one visible panel, ARIA and roving tabindex
Tab keyboard navigation and modal image/alt/title/focus use actual listeners
Default JSON has contract schema, 17 open records, zero accepted checks and fixture scope
Actual JSON exports every hidden status/Unicode note/asset plus free notes and active tab
Actual export button generates distinct safe filenames and serializes JSON
Copy listener serializes state; unavailable clipboard selects JSON fallback
Native, prior and concept images are labelled separately and all local image paths exist
Source has no external dependency or network request and records template origin
